snippet.title: Velato Gameplay Highlight #deckbuilder #roguelike #steam
snippet.description:
VELATO - The First Single-player Poker-Bluff Roguelike Deckbuilder
Bluff | Challenge | AI | Poker | Roguelike | Deckbuilder | Declare | Strategy

What Is VELATO?
VELATO is a single-player Poker-Bluff Roguelike Deckbuilder where players build a Joker-driven economy engine, manipulate AI opponents through bluffing, and survive escalating table pressure across each run.

- A bluff-driven roguelike deckbuilder built for risk-takers and over-thinkers alike.
- Buy, sell, raise, and lie. Every hand is a market, a AI-mind game, and a math puzzle in one.

Do you dare to play? 🤡
